value.rationale: The sharp Nikolskii constant of \(\operatorname{span}\{1,z,z^2\}\) is a natural exact invariant of the smallest nontrivial analytic polynomial space at the cubic self-convolution level. The theorem also classifies every extremizer and shows that the equal-amplitude trinomial is not sharp, revealing a nontrivial algebraic amplitude ratio rather than a routine phase or normalization check.
